tools.name: codecov_list_service_owners
tools.description: List owners (organizations/users) the token can see on a git service. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/.

tools.name: codecov_get_owner
tools.description: Get a single owner (org/user) detail. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/.

tools.name: codecov_list_users
tools.description: List users belonging to an owner (org), optionally filtered by activation/admin/search. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/users/.

tools.name: codecov_list_repos
tools.description: List repositories for an owner, optionally filtered by active state, names or search. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/.

tools.name: codecov_get_repo
tools.description: Get a single repository's detail. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/.

tools.name: codecov_get_repo_config
tools.description: Get a repository's Codecov configuration. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/config/.

tools.name: codecov_list_branches
tools.description: List a repository's branches, optionally filtered by author and ordering. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/branches/.

tools.name: codecov_get_branch
tools.description: Get a single branch's detail, including its head commit's coverage totals. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/branches/{name}/.

tools.name: codecov_list_commits
tools.description: List a repository's commits, optionally filtered by branch. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/commits/.

tools.name: codecov_get_commit
tools.description: Get a single commit's detail, including its coverage totals and report. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/commits/{commitid}/.

tools.name: codecov_list_commit_uploads
tools.description: List the coverage report uploads recorded for a commit. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/commits/{commitid}/uploads/.

tools.name: codecov_list_pulls
tools.description: List a repository's pull requests, optionally filtered by state and start date. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/pulls/.

tools.name: codecov_get_pull
tools.description: Get a single pull request's detail, including its base/head coverage. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/pulls/{pullid}/.

tools.name: codecov_get_coverage_totals
tools.description: Coverage totals for a commit (defaults to default branch head), plus per-file totals. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/totals/.

tools.name: codecov_get_coverage_report
tools.description: Full coverage report for a commit (defaults to default branch head) — totals plus per-file line coverage. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/report/.

tools.name: codecov_get_report_tree
tools.description: Coverage report as a file/directory tree for a commit (defaults to default branch head). Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/report/tree.

tools.name: codecov_get_file_coverage
tools.description: Line-by-line coverage for a single file. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/file_report/{path}/.

tools.name: codecov_get_coverage_trend
tools.description: Coverage measurements over time for a repository, bucketed by interval. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/coverage/.

tools.name: codecov_list_flags
tools.description: List a repository's coverage flags. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/flags/.

tools.name: codecov_get_flag_coverage_trend
tools.description: Coverage measurements over time for a single flag, bucketed by interval. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/flags/{flag_name}/coverage/.

tools.name: codecov_list_components
tools.description: List a repository's components with their coverage. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/components/.

tools.name: codecov_compare
tools.description: Compare coverage between two commits (base vs. head) or for a pull request. Provide EITHER both `base` and `head`, OR `pullid`. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/compare/.

tools.name: codecov_compare_impacted_files
tools.description: List the files whose coverage changed between two commits (base vs. head) or for a pull request. Provide EITHER both `base` and `head`, OR `pullid`. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/compare/impacted_files.

tools.name: codecov_list_test_results
tools.description: List a repository's test-analytics results, optionally filtered by branch, commit, outcome and duration. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/test-results/.
